[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Twin to Hugh. Married Abraham Cunningham.

From ''History of Allegheny County, Pennsylvania'':
<blockquote>  
Abraham and Nancy (Glasgow) Cunningham,
who were born in Ireland, and came
here when they were eight and ten years of
age, residing in West Deer township until
their deaths.
</blockquote>

From ''Memoirs of Allegheny County, Pennsylvania'':
<blockquote>
Abraham and Nancy (Glasgow) Cunningham
left their native soil in Ireland and
crossed the ocean in search of a new
home in the western wilderness. They
located first in Butler county, Pa., but
later removed to Allegheny county, and
bought the 200 acres of land which is now
in the possession of his grandsons. The father died about 1861,
and his wife in 1865. They left a son named Hugh Cunningham,...
</blockquote>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-540]] is assessed at 78% (probable). Hugh’s will explicitly names daughter Nancy, and the family history/local Cunningham accounts form a compatible family context. Identifying that daughter with Abraham Cunningham’s wife remains inferred, with a 1796/1810 emigration discrepancy.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.

Next useful test: Find a family Bible, deed or probate naming the child’s full adult identity; compare the family history with the 1827 will.
